final:
No match found — so I didn't add the reaction.

In **#incident-review** there's exactly one checkout-outage message: *"Checkout outage dashboard: errors on /pay spiking since 11:40 UTC, link inside."* — but it was posted by **Ruth Okafor, who's a Data Engineer**, not a Data Analyst.

The Data Analysts in the workspace are Carla Jensen and Sergio Vega (both still employed), and neither posted that message — their profiles don't list a Chicago location either. (Nadia Rahman is a Data Analyst but has left the company.)

If you actually want the eyes reaction on Ruth's message, or a different message by Carla/Sergio, say the word and I'll add it.
